영어.ex: 저는 영어하고 한국어를 할 수 있어요.
영어.x: I can speak English and Korean.

파란색.x: The sky is clear, so the sea is blue too.
파란색.e: From native 파랗다 'to be blue', modifier 파란, plus 색.
파란색.t: 파란 can also cover green in set phrases like 파란불 'green light'.

죽.ex: 아플 때는 따뜻한 죽을 먹는 게 좋아요.
죽.x: When you're sick, it's good to eat warm porridge.
죽.e: Proverb: 죽 쒀서 개 준다, 'cook porridge and give it to the dog' — wasted effort.
죽.t: Koreans eat 죽 when they're sick, the way Americans eat chicken soup.

막걸리.ex: 비 오는 날에는 파전에 막걸리가 생각나요.
막걸리.x: On rainy days, I crave pajeon with makgeolli.
막걸리.e: Native word: 막 'roughly, just' + 거르다 'to strain' — roughly strained rice wine.
막걸리.t: Pronounced [막껄리]. Milky and lightly sparkling; it's often drunk from small bowls. Rainy days and 파전 (green onion pancake) go with it.

대기업.ex: 많은 대학생들이 대기업에 취업하고 싶어 해요.
대기업.x: Many college students want to get jobs at big companies.

향수.x: My older sister puts on perfume every time she goes out.
향수.t: Use 뿌리다 for putting on perfume; a different 향수 means homesickness or nostalgia.

향수.ex: 오래된 노래를 들으니 고향에 대한 향수가 밀려왔어요.
향수.x: Listening to old songs, a wave of nostalgia for my hometown came over me.
향수.t: Homonym: 향수(香水) means perfume; context tells them apart.

세계적.x: That singer is now famous worldwide.
세계적.e: -적 = '-ic/-al,' a hugely productive suffix: 세계적, 국제적, 경제적.
세계적.t: Use 세계적인 before a noun (세계적인 회사) and 세계적으로 before a verb or adjective.

흥분하다.m: to get excited; to get worked up, to get agitated
흥분하다.ex: 너무 흥분하지 말고 천천히 얘기해 보세요.
흥분하다.x: Don't get so worked up — try talking it through slowly.
흥분하다.t: 흥분하다 often means getting agitated or angry; for happy excitement, 신나다 is usually more natural.
rel: to be excited, to have fun

송금하다.m: to send money, to transfer money (remit)
송금하다.ex: 지난주에 미국에 계신 부모님께 돈을 송금했어요.
송금하다.x: Last week I sent money to my parents in the U.S.
송금하다.t: 송금 is often used for sending money abroad; between local accounts, 이체 is more common.

장수.ex: 할아버지는 장수의 비결이 규칙적인 생활이라고 하세요.
장수.x: My grandfather says the secret to a long life is a regular routine.
장수.e: Literally 'long life'. Homonym: 장수 also means 'merchant' or 'general'.
장수.t: To wish an elder a long life, say 오래오래 건강하세요.

학사.ex: 학사 학위가 있어야 이 일에 지원할 수 있어요.
학사.x: You need a bachelor's degree to apply for this job.

전시장.ex: 전시장 안에서는 음식을 드시면 안 됩니다.
전시장.x: You may not eat inside the exhibition hall.

기술력.ex: 한국 기업들은 뛰어난 기술력을 가지고 있어요.
기술력.x: Korean companies have outstanding technological capabilities.

특허권.ex: 그 회사는 신제품의 특허권을 가지고 있어요.
특허권.x: That company holds the patent for the new product.
특허권.t: Pronounced [트커꿘] — ㄱ and ㅎ merge into ㅋ.

빼앗기다.m: to be robbed of, have (something) taken away
빼앗기다.x: I was completely captivated by that movie.
빼앗기다.t: 마음을 빼앗기다 literally 'to have your heart taken' means to be captivated.

상해.x: He was arrested by the police on charges of assault causing injury.
상해.t: Homonym: 상해 (上海) is also the city of Shanghai.

동조하다.m: to side with, to go along with; to conform
동조하다.x: Many people sided with his opinion.
동조하다.e: Literally 'to be in the same tune'.
동조하다.t: Takes 에 (의견에 동조하다) and often suggests going along with the crowd.

약자.ex: 강자보다 약자의 편에 서는 사람이 되고 싶어요.
약자.x: I want to be someone who takes the side of the weak rather than the strong.
약자.t: Homonym: 약자 can also mean an abbreviation; context makes it clear.

동일시하다.m: to identify with, to equate, to regard as the same
동일시하다.ex: 아이들은 종종 자신을 만화 주인공과 동일시해요.
동일시하다.x: Children often identify themselves with cartoon heroes.
동일시하다.e: Literally 'regard as one and the same'.
동일시하다.t: Pattern A를 B와 동일시하다 = to equate A with B.

재조명하다.m: to shed new light on, to revisit, to reexamine
재조명하다.ex: 이 다큐멘터리는 잊힌 독립운동가의 삶을 재조명합니다.
재조명하다.x: This documentary sheds new light on the life of a forgotten independence activist.

묵살하다.m: to ignore, to brush aside, to disregard (opinions, requests)
묵살하다.x: The company brushed aside the employees' demands.

동분서주.m: rushing around busily, running here and there
동분서주.ex: 그는 회사를 살리려고 한 달 내내 동분서주했어요.
동분서주.x: He rushed around all month long trying to save the company.

국제화.ex: 대학들이 국제화를 위해 외국인 교수를 많이 뽑고 있어요.
국제화.x: Universities are hiring many foreign professors to become more international.

핑계.ex: 그는 바쁘다는 핑계로 모임에 오지 않았어요.
핑계.x: He didn't come to the gathering, using being busy as an excuse.
핑계.t: Key patterns: 핑계를 대다 (make an excuse) and -다는 핑계로 (using the excuse that ...).

기진맥진.m: utter exhaustion, being completely worn out
기진맥진.x: I moved house all day, so I'm completely worn out.
기진맥진.e: Literally 'energy used up, pulse used up'.
기진맥진.t: Pronounced [기진맥찐]. Common as 기진맥진하다 / 기진맥진한 상태; casual equivalent: 녹초가 되다.

증뢰.ex: 건설사 사장은 증뢰 혐의로 재판을 받았어요.
증뢰.x: The construction company president was tried for offering bribes.
증뢰.e: Literally 'giving a bribe'; the counterpart of the receiving side.
증뢰.t: Pronounced [증뇌]: ㄹ after ㅇ becomes ㄴ.

영업이익.x: Third-quarter operating profit rose 20 percent from last year.
영업이익.t: 영업이익 is profit from the core business; 순이익 is what's left after everything, including taxes.

식민주의.ex: 많은 아시아 국가들이 식민주의의 피해를 입었습니다.
식민주의.x: Many Asian countries suffered under colonialism.
식민주의.e: Literally 'planting people' — settling one's own people in another land.

불안장애.ex: 불안장애가 있는 사람은 작은 일에도 크게 걱정해요.
불안장애.x: People with anxiety disorders worry a lot even about small things.

원자핵.x: An atomic nucleus is made up of protons and neutrons.

독주회.ex: 그 바이올리니스트는 다음 달에 첫 독주회를 엽니다.
독주회.x: That violinist is holding her first solo recital next month.
독주회.t: For singers, use 독창회; 독주회 is for instrumentalists.

합주.ex: 동아리 친구들과 매주 토요일에 합주를 해요.
합주.x: I play together with my club friends every Saturday.
합주.t: Pair it with its singing twin: 합주 for instruments, 합창 for voices.

급제.ex: 그는 여러 번의 도전 끝에 과거에 급제했어요.
급제.x: After many attempts, he finally passed the state examination.
급제.e: Literally 'reaching the rank' of successful candidates.
급제.t: Used with 에: 과거에 급제하다; for modern exams say 합격하다.

척결하다.m: to root out, to eradicate (corruption, evils)
척결하다.ex: 새 정부는 부정부패를 반드시 척결하겠다고 약속했습니다.
척결하다.x: The new government promised to root out corruption without fail.
척결하다.e: Literally 'gouge and pick out' — cutting out something rotten.
척결하다.t: Mainly used with social evils: 비리, 부패, 적폐를 척결하다.
